nodes.name: Identity Core
nodes.purpose: Root namespace for all platform participants, credentials, and access domains.
nodes.ux_intent: An invisible foundational layer that ensures absolute clarity on who is interacting with the system.
nodes.vertical_notes: Foundation for nanny, cleaner, client, and anon interactions.

nodes.name: Person Entity
nodes.purpose: Groups operations related to the core human entity traversing the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: The user is treated as a unified human being, preventing duplicated profiles.
nodes.vertical_notes: A single person might be a cleaner in Agency A, and a client booking a nanny in Agency B.

nodes.name: Create Person Record
nodes.purpose: Instantiates a new global person identity or a 'shadow' placeholder if initiated by an admin.
nodes.ux_intent: Admin can effortlessly add a placeholder worker/client in seconds; the person feels known when they arrive later.
open_questions: What is the primary deduplication key for shadow persons? (Email vs Phone)
nodes.vertical_notes: Admins can add 'Jane, nanny, 555-1234' with no account to immediately assign her to a caregiving shift.
nodes.case_integration: Shadow persons do not sync to Case until claimed.

nodes.name: Claim Shadow Profile
nodes.purpose: Allows an unregistered worker or client to take ownership of a pre-existing shadow profile.
nodes.ux_intent: A magic-link experience where the worker clicks and says 'Yes, this is me!'—zero manual data entry.
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for onboarding legacy cleaning or nanny staff smoothly without requiring them to set up accounts upfront.
nodes.case_integration: Triggers the creation of their unified Case Portfolio, backfilling all historical shifts worked as a shadow.

nodes.name: Update Person Profile
nodes.purpose: Updates core biological or contact attributes of the person entity.
nodes.ux_intent: Fields save instantly on blur, reassuring the user without disruptive save buttons.
open_questions: Should name changes trigger a re-verification of the DBS check?
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies and cleaners must ensure contact info is exact for emergency communications with families.
nodes.case_integration: Updates sync immediately to their Case profile.

nodes.name: Deactivate Person
nodes.purpose: Soft-deletes the person's identity and revokes all active platform access.
nodes.ux_intent: A solemn but clear offboarding flow that gracefully terminates future bookings while preserving payout history.
open_questions: How do we handle upcoming booked shifts when a worker is deactivated?
nodes.vertical_notes: Required if a caregiver loses a critical safeguarding clearance or a cleaner violates trust.
nodes.case_integration: Case portfolio is sealed; no new activity can be recorded.

nodes.name: View Own Profile
nodes.purpose: Retrieves the full aggregated view of the person's identity, memberships, and credentials.
nodes.ux_intent: A highly visual, reassuring 'passport' view showing the user exactly how agencies and clients see them.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies see their public-facing biography alongside their verified internal credentials.
nodes.case_integration: Displays a direct link to their public Case Portfolio URL.

nodes.name: Organization Entity
nodes.purpose: Groups operations for agencies, care homes, or corporate clients.
nodes.ux_intent: Provides a robust structure for B2B or B2B2C interactions, remaining mostly invisible to end consumers.
nodes.vertical_notes: An org could be 'Sunny Smiles Nanny Agency' or 'Downtown Commercial Cleaners'.

nodes.name: Create Organization
nodes.purpose: Registers a new agency or commercial client onto the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: A seamless setup wizard that instantly generates their operational workspace.
nodes.vertical_notes: Important for distinguishing between residential family clients and commercial cleaning/care home clients.
nodes.case_integration: The org becomes a verified issuer of work history on Case portfolios.

nodes.name: Update Organization
nodes.purpose: Modifies core details of the agency or commercial client.
nodes.ux_intent: Form fields that autosave, ensuring the agency's public profile is always up-to-date.
nodes.vertical_notes: Allows updating public-facing agency details like 'Ofsted Registration Number' for childcare agencies.
nodes.case_integration: Updates the issuer branding on all workers' Case portfolios.

nodes.name: Suspend Organization
nodes.purpose: Temporarily freezes all activity for an organization (e.g., due to non-payment or compliance failure).
nodes.ux_intent: Clear, unmissable banners explaining the suspension with an immediate, frictionless resolution path.
open_questions: Do active nanny shifts get cancelled immediately upon agency suspension?
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial if a care agency loses regulatory approval and must immediately cease dispatching workers.
nodes.case_integration: Suspends the org's ability to issue new verified work records to Case.

nodes.name: Close Organization
nodes.purpose: Permanently shuts down the organization and terminates all active memberships.
nodes.ux_intent: A highly intentional, irreversible action requiring typed confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.
open_questions: How long is historical compliance data retained for closed childcare agencies?
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregivers and cleaners must still retain access to their historical payout and tax data.
nodes.case_integration: Org is marked as defunct, but previously issued Case work history remains cryptographically valid.

nodes.name: View Organization Settings
nodes.purpose: Retrieves the organizational configuration and global preferences.
nodes.ux_intent: A perfectly categorized settings pane where admins can find what they need in under 3 seconds.
nodes.vertical_notes: Includes toggles for 'Require Paediatric First Aid' or 'Require COSHH Training' globally.

nodes.name: Membership Link
nodes.purpose: Manages the many-to-many relationship between persons and organizations.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers seamlessly switch contexts between different agencies without logging in and out.
nodes.vertical_notes: A person might be a 'Worker' in the Nanny Agency, but a 'Client' in the Cleaning Agency.

nodes.name: Create Membership
nodes.purpose: Links a person to an organization with a specific role (worker, client, admin).
nodes.ux_intent: An instant, satisfying confirmation that the person is now part of the agency.
nodes.vertical_notes: When a family (client) signs up for nanny services, they are given a client membership to the agency.
nodes.case_integration: Authorizes the agency to append records to the worker's Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: Change Membership Role
nodes.purpose: Updates the permissions and relationship type of a person within an org.
nodes.ux_intent: A simple dropdown selection that instantly reconfigures the user's dashboard upon next load.
nodes.vertical_notes: E.g., upgrading a Senior Caregiver to an Agency Admin role so they can dispatch others.

nodes.name: Suspend Membership
nodes.purpose: Temporarily blocks a person from acting within a specific organization without destroying their history.
nodes.ux_intent: A respectful but firm state change that hides the worker from dispatch without deleting data.
open_questions: Does suspending a client automatically cancel their recurring cleaning schedules?
nodes.vertical_notes: Used when a caregiver's DBS check expires and they must be grounded until a new one is uploaded.

nodes.name: Terminate Membership
nodes.purpose: Permanently ends the relationship between the person and the organization.
nodes.ux_intent: Clean severance. The worker disappears from the active roster but remains in historical billing reports.
nodes.vertical_notes: When a nanny leaves an agency, they keep their global platform account (and Case Portfolio) but lose agency access.
nodes.case_integration: Closes the active employment chapter on their Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: View Roster
nodes.purpose: Allows agency admins to see all active and suspended workers or clients.
nodes.ux_intent: A lightning-fast, sortable, beautifully animated list with inline quick-actions.
nodes.vertical_notes: Admins can toggle between 'Cleaners', 'Nannies', and 'Families'. Indicators show expiring credentials instantly.

nodes.name: Credential Engine
nodes.purpose: Handles the ingestion, validation, and lifecycle of specialized compliance documents as unstructured data assertions.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers take a photo of a certificate; the system magically extracts the data and turns it green.
nodes.vertical_notes: Data-not-schema approach: A 'Credential' can be anything from a DBS Check to a Carpet Cleaning Cert.

nodes.name: Submit Credential
nodes.purpose: Allows a worker to upload proof of a required compliance qualification.
nodes.ux_intent: A playful, frictionless upload flow that immediately OCRs the document and gives instant reassurance.
open_questions: Can we auto-verify DBS checks against the UK government update service API?
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregivers submit NVQ Level 3, Paediatric First Aid, DBS. Cleaners submit COSHH, manual handling.
nodes.case_integration: Verified credentials become foundational trust badges on the Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: Review Credential
nodes.purpose: Enables an admin to manually approve or reject a submitted credential.
nodes.ux_intent: A split-screen view: document on the left, fields on the right, approved with a single confident keystroke.
nodes.vertical_notes: Admins must check that the DBS certificate is clear of safeguarding concerns before assigning a nanny.
nodes.case_integration: Approval writes a verified credential block to the worker's Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: Expire Credential
nodes.purpose: Background process that invalidates credentials that have passed their valid-until date.
nodes.ux_intent: Silent, robust automation that protects the agency from compliance breaches without human intervention.
nodes.vertical_notes: If a CPR cert expires, the caregiver is instantly removed from the dispatch pool for future medical shifts.
nodes.case_integration: Updates the Case Portfolio badge from 'Active' to 'Historical/Expired'.

nodes.name: Revoke Credential
nodes.purpose: Manually invalidates a credential before its natural expiry (e.g., if fraud is discovered).
nodes.ux_intent: An emergency brake that feels secure and immediately halts the worker's operational capacity.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used if a caregiver's Ofsted registration is suspended by the regulator.
nodes.case_integration: Burns the credential badge from the Case Portfolio permanently.

nodes.name: View Credential Dashboard
nodes.purpose: Provides the worker with a unified view of all their required and optional compliance documents.
nodes.ux_intent: A highly visual progress ring showing 100% compliance, creating a sense of professional pride.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaners see exactly which commercial certs they are missing to qualify for higher-paying office jobs.

nodes.name: Send Renewal Reminder
nodes.purpose: Proactively notifies a worker when a vital credential is 30/14/7 days from expiry.
nodes.ux_intent: A helpful, friendly nudge (SMS/Push) that includes a one-tap magic link to upload the new document.
nodes.vertical_notes: Keeps nannies compliant without agency admins having to chase them via email.

nodes.name: Settlement Account
nodes.purpose: Manages the financial endpoints linked to a person or org for payouts and charges.
nodes.ux_intent: Completely abstracts away the complexity of Stripe/Plaid; it just looks like 'Where money goes'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Vital for gig-economy routing: caregivers need payout accounts, clients need charge methods.

nodes.name: Link Settlement Account
nodes.purpose: Attaches a bank account or debit card to a person for receiving payouts or processing refunds.
nodes.ux_intent: A fluid, embedded financial flow that feels as easy as adding a card to Apple Pay.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaners link their bank accounts to receive their weekly payouts from the platform.

nodes.name: Verify Settlement Account
nodes.purpose: Triggers KYC/KYB checks on the linked account to ensure regulatory compliance.
nodes.ux_intent: Happens silently in the background; the user only sees a celebratory 'Verified' checkmark.
open_questions: What happens to pending payouts while verification is in progress?
nodes.vertical_notes: Care agencies must ensure caregiver bank names match their identity to prevent fraud.

nodes.name: Remove Settlement Account
nodes.purpose: Detaches a payout or charge method from the person's profile.
nodes.ux_intent: A simple swipe-to-delete that gracefully handles replacement if it's the default account.
nodes.vertical_notes: If a family removes their primary card, they must add a new one before booking the next nanny shift.

nodes.name: Set Escrow Preference
nodes.purpose: Configures how funds are held and routed (e.g., instant payout vs. weekly batch).
nodes.ux_intent: A clean toggle switch allowing workers to choose between 'Get paid now (fee)' or 'Get paid Friday (free)'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Very popular with gig cleaners who may want instant payouts after a shift.

nodes.name: Anonymous Client Domain
nodes.purpose: Manages transient identities for users who book services without creating a persistent account.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero friction; the user flows from landing page to booked service without hitting a signup wall.
nodes.vertical_notes: Allows a desperate parent to book an emergency one-off babysitter without account fatigue.

nodes.name: Create Anon Session
nodes.purpose: Generates a transient, cookie/token-based identity to anchor an ongoing booking flow.
nodes.ux_intent: Happens silently in the background the moment they click 'Book Now', securing their spot seamlessly.
open_questions: How long should anon booking sessions live before expiring?
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for conversion rates in consumer-facing cleaning services.

nodes.name: Upgrade Anon to Account
nodes.purpose: Converts a transient anonymous session into a fully persistent person account post-booking.
nodes.ux_intent: A delightful 'post-purchase' screen that says 'Save your details for next time?' and requires exactly one password field.
nodes.vertical_notes: Transforms a one-off end-of-tenancy cleaning client into a recurring customer.

nodes.name: Track Anon Bookings
nodes.purpose: Allows an anonymous client to view and modify their upcoming booking using a magic link sent to their email.
nodes.ux_intent: Total empowerment without the login barrier; a single click from their inbox opens a secure portal.
open_questions: What authentication level is required to cancel an anon booking via magic link?
nodes.vertical_notes: A parent can check who their assigned nanny is and view their Case Portfolio via this link without logging in.
